About Acme Corp

Acme Corp builds enterprise data infrastructure used by more than eight thousand customers worldwide. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company has raised three hundred and ten million dollars across four funding rounds.

The engineering organisation is led by Jane Smith, Vice President of Engineering, who joined in 2021. The team of approximately one hundred and twenty engineers operates across three pillars: infrastructure, data platform, and developer experience. Acme has been recognised for its commitment to internal mobility and for its open-source contributions to the Apache ecosystem.

Acme's products help finance, healthcare, and retail companies consolidate disparate data sources and deliver real-time analytics to operational teams. The platform processes more than twelve trillion events per month and powers mission-critical workloads for several Fortune 500 customers. The company maintains certifications including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and HIPAA where applicable to its healthcare deployments.
